title_en: Share of Zarak Tops Arqana November Online Sale
description: The share in Aga Khan Studs stallion Zarak tops the Nov. 10 Arqana November Online Sale.

title_en: Meeks Earns Juan Saez Leading Apprentice Jockey Award
description: Following a strong racing season from start to finish, apprentice jockey Micah Meeks was honored with the 13th annual Juan Saez Leading Apprentice Jockey Award during closing week of the 2026 racing season at Horseshoe Indianapolis.

title_en: British Racing Leans Into Traceability in New Plan
description: British racing launched its next five-year Horse Welfare Strategy Nov. 10, setting out 20 priorities to drive further improvements in the welfare and safety of Thoroughbreds throughout their lives.

title_en: With Success Building, Shirer Enters Claiming Crown
description: A decade after beginning his career with a zero-horse stable, Matt Shirer's growing success has led to three starters in the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Shirer Discusses His Three Claiming Crown Entrants
description: Trainer Matt Shirer discusses his three entrants for the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs: Talkin in Cursive ($100,000 Empress), Five o' Somewhere ($125,000 Rapid Transit), and Light the Way ($175,000 Emerald).

title_en: Racing's 'Backbone' Horses Compete in Claiming Crown
description: The backbone of the racing industry, claiming horses, compete in their own championship event Nov. 14 when $1.2 million in purses is on the line at Churchill Downs during the Claiming Crown.

title_en: Keeneland Supplements Winning Filly Yerwan to HORA Sale
description: Yerwan, a 2-year-old daughter of Caracaro coming off a Nov. 7 victory at Woodbine, has been added to Keeneland's November Horses of Racing Age Sale Nov. 12. A total of 136 horses are cataloged to the auction, which begins at noon ET.

title_en: Brown's Barrel Roll, Bletchley Emerge As Hot Prospects
description: Two Chad Brown-trained sons of Three Chimneys Farm stallion Gun Runner, Barrel Roll and Bletchley, are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after quick wet-track victories last week.

title_en: Haulin Ice, Two Other Joseph Trainees Top Dream Supreme
description: Trainer Saffie Joseph Jr.'s graded stakes-winning trio of Haulin Ice, Indy Bay and Mystic Lake leads a compact field of six filly and mare sprinters entered in the $300,000 Dream Supreme Stakes Nov. 14 Churchill Downs.

title_en: 22-Year-Old Australian Jockey Neale Dies After Fall
description: Australian jockey Izzy Neale has died at age 22 following a race fall Nov. 8 at Warren. The apprentice rider had been in a critical condition at Dubbo Hospital in New South Wales, after suffering a fall aboard Marnoo in the Warren Shire Cotton Cup.

title_en: HIWU Issues Seven-Day Suspensions to Pletcher, Kintz
description: In a pair of resolved cases involving controlled medications, the Horseracing Integrity and Welfare Unit has issued seven-day suspensions to trainers Todd Pletcher and Matt Kintz.

title_en: Ombudsman to Run in Japan Cup Before Heading to Stud
description: Godolphin's Ombudsman, one of the world's top racehorses, is poised for one final start before his retirement to stud. The five-time group 1 winner is pointed to the Nov. 29 Japan Cup (G1) at Tokyo Racecourse, Racing Post reported.

title_en: USA Network to Air Upcoming Horse Racing League Events
description: USA Sports and The Horse Racing League announced a partnership Nov. 10 to air all three inaugural HRL race days live on USA Network in 2027.

title_en: New Schedule, Facility Upgrades Coming to Fairmount
description: Fairmount Park will debut a new paddock, new jockeys' quarters, and a new racing office, and will make changes to its racing schedule in 2027 to enhance the experience for fans.

title_en: Gerry Dilger Scholarship Foundation Names Recipients
description: The board of the Gerry Dilger Scholarship Foundation announced Nov. 10, the two newest recipients of scholarships awarded to young American horse people to the Irish National Stud in Kildare—Emmy Schmidt and Marcum McLean.

title_en: Night of Thunder to Stand for European Record in 2027
description: Unbeaten classic hero Bow Echo will stand in 2027 at Dalham Hall in Newmarket, while his sire Night of Thunder's fee will make him the most expensive stallion in European history.

title_en: Ted Noffey Retired to Stud; Further Ado to Keep Racing
description: Spendthrift Farm announced Nov. 10 that reigning champion 2-year-old male Ted Noffey will retire to stud for the 2027 breeding season. The farm also confirmed that Further Ado will remain in training after his win in the Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile (G1).

title_en: Dollars & Sense: An Approving Word From the Sponsor
description: Dollars & Sense with Frank Angst looks at Visa's return as a sponsor of the Kentucky Derby (G1) and Churchill Downs.

title_en: Weanlings Dominate Day 7 at Keeneland November Sale
description: During the second day of Book 4, a total of 257 horses were sold for $8,658,000, including post-ring sales, for an average of $33,689 and a median of $25,000.

title_en: Englishman Retired From Racing, to Stand at Lane's End
description: Two-time grade 1 winner Englishman has been retired to Lane's End. He will stand for $50,000 in 2027 at the farm near Versailles, Ky.

title_en: BH Monday: Claiming Crown Takes Center Stage
description: On the Nov. 9 episode of BloodHorse Monday: National Horsemen's Benevolent and Protective Association CEO Eric Hamelback discusses this weekend's Claiming Crown, and Weatherbys' Nick Craven talks international racing and the Global Stallion App.

title_en: Group 1 Winner Hotazhell Heads Haras d'Etreham's Roster
description: Triple group 1 winner Hotazhell will begin his stallion career at Haras d'Etreham at a fee of €15,000 next year, heading the French stud's seven-strong roster for 2027.

title_en: Frankel Leads Juddmonte Stallion Roster for 2027
description: Juddmonte's new group 1 star Field of Gold will begin his stallion career next year at a fee of £20,000, while the leading European operation has opted to keep its flagship sire Frankel at £350,000.

title_en: NMRHOF Closed for Renovation Dec. 28-April 30
description: The National Museum of Racing and Hall of Fame will be closed to the public from Dec. 28 through April 30 for the renovation and reimagining of gallery space and new exhibition installations. It will re-open for its annual Kentucky Derby Party May 1.

title_en: Charles Town Track Superintendent Bowling to Retire
description: Track superintendent Doug Bowling has announced his retirement from that role, concluding a career that spanned nearly 50 years with Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races. Bowling will be succeeded by assistant track superintendent Warren Cogle.

title_en: D'Amato Loads Up for Del Mar's Turf Festival
description: One of Del Mar's leading trainers is looking forward to a busy next couple of weeks at the seaside oval. Philip D'Amato has a few of his big-name horses geared up for the Turf Festival at the end of the month.

description: J.C. Smith's group 2 winner Venetian Prince will ship to New York for the $500,000 Jockey Club Derby (G2T) Nov. 28 at Belmont Park.
